item.description: THERE will be a contested Constable election in St Helier after a former Education Minister confirmed her candidacy. item.description: By Bernard Place THE death of Jesse Jackson feels like the closing of a chapter. item.title: Recruitment boost fades as Grouville’s honorary police force shrinks
